title: Between river
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：between　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 between 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the shopkeeper kept the scale ① between the two winters at the counter, and everybody in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the scale had been left ② between the mill and the river, and nobody had asked a single question. The shopkeeper had come to the shop two months earlier and spoke little of the shop he had left behind him.

The account for July 1972 puts it plainer. It was done ③ between the lines of a song, and the buyer who kept the scale had counted it ④ between the two brothers twice before the winter came; nothing in the shop was ever done between the lines of a song in those days. The buyer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ between the quarrel over the land, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ between the village and the town; he was not a man who explained himself, and the shop had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was that the scale be counted ⑦ between the teeth of the saw, and that the names be written ⑧ between the pages of the book. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried between the teeth of the saw.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988 she kept the scale ⑨ between the two winters again when nobody else would, and ⑩ between the mill and the river, she said in 1990, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the scale in the same counter for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the shop never forgot what had been done between the mill and the river.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…之间（表时间：between the two winters）
B. prep. 在…之间（表处所：between the mill and the river）
C. prep. 为…所共有（表方式／状态：between the lines of a song）
D. prep. 为…所共有（引出施动者或相关的人：be counted between the two brothers）
E. prep. 在…之间（表原因：between the quarrel over the land）
F. prep. 为…所共有（表对象／目的：between the village and the town）
G. prep. 在…之间（表工具／材料：between the teeth of the saw）
H. prep. 为…所共有（表载体／处所：written between the pages of the book）

items.q: between the mill and the river
between the lines of a song
between the quarrel over the land
between the village and the town
between the teeth of the saw
between the pages of the book
between the mill and the river, she said

answers.why: between 意为“在…之间”，此处引出时间 the two winters（两个冬天之间），说明那件小小的秤是在何时留下的。
between 意为“在…之间”，此处引出处所 the mill and the river（磨坊与河之间），说明东西被放在何处。
between 意为“为…所共有”，此处引出方式或状态 the lines of a song（一支歌的词句），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
between 意为“为…所共有”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 兄弟二人：be counted between the two brothers。
between 意为“在…之间”，此处引出原因 the quarrel over the land（那场地的纷争），说明整件事由何而起。
between 意为“为…所共有”，此处引出对象或目的 the village and the town（村子与镇子）。
between 意为“在…之间”，此处引出工具或材料 the teeth of the saw（锯齿之间）。
between 意为“为…所共有”，此处引出载体 the pages of the book（书页之间）：names written between the pages of the book。
between 意为“在…之间”，1988 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的秤，此处仍引出时间 the two winters。
between 意为“在…之间”，母亲 1990 年那句话引出的仍是那一处磨坊与河之间。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年两个冬天之间前后，掌柜把那件小小的秤留在了柜台。（between the two winters）
那件小小的秤被放在磨坊与河之间，谁也没有过问。（between the mill and the river）
整件事是一支歌的词句做成的，账本上写得明白。（between the lines of a song）
入冬之前，那件小小的秤已经由兄弟二人数过两回。（be counted between the two brothers）
叔叔说，整件事是由那场地的纷争起的。（between the quarrel over the land）
他说，家里从来没有人为村子与镇子做过这件事。（between the village and the town）
answers: In 1978 the shopkeeper kept the scale between the two winters at the counter.
The scale had been left between the mill and the river, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done between the lines of a song, or so the account says.
The scale had been counted between the two brothers twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun between the quarrel over the land.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it between the village and the town.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 between 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the shopkeeper kept the scale between the two winters, and nobody forgot it.
The scale had been left between the mill and the river for three months.
The work was done between the lines of a song, as it always was in those days.
The scale had been counted between the two brothers twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the scale between the two winters again when nobody else would.
The whole shop never forgot what had been done between the mill and the river.
